classification.question_topic: Survey-style questions about correlations with Mall World dreams (chronic pain/stress, surgery/oxycodone, nicotine patches, lucid dreaming practice, mental health conditions like ADHD/anxiety) and whether these relate to vividness/frequency.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream narrative or describable locations/events; only general statements about having vivid Mall World dreams during certain conditions.

meta.author_theory: Suggests Mall World dreams may function as an escape from chronic pain/stress; wonders if surgery/pain meds (oxycodone), nicotine patches/nicotine use during sleep, lucid dreaming practice, or ADHD/anxiety correlate with vivid Mall World dreams.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological dream content is not provided (no described scenes, sensory qualities, entities, or navigation). Only temporal/conditional context is mentioned: vivid Mall World dreams occurred around tonsil surgery while taking oxycodone and while sleeping with nicotine patches/using nicotine; author reports a few lucid dreaming episodes (often wakes from excitement).
